requirements.statement: Admins sign in through the shared IDP to access the admin app

criteria.must: An Admin can sign in through the shared identity provider and reach the admin app
An unauthenticated visitor to the admin app is redirected to sign in
An Admin can create a new guest account with a name and email
A newly provisioned guest account appears in the Admin's list of guest accounts
An Admin can create a new asset record with name, category, status, condition and location

requirements.statement: Admins can view the full list of assets

criteria.must: An Admin can view a list showing every asset in inventory, regardless of who it is assigned to

requirements.statement: Admins can update an asset record

criteria.must: An Admin can change an existing asset's status, condition, location or assigned owner and the change is saved

requirements.statement: Admins can delete an asset record

criteria.must: An Admin can delete an asset record and it no longer appears in the inventory list

requirements.statement: Guests sign in through the shared IDP to access the guest app

criteria.must: A provisioned Guest can sign in through the shared identity provider and reach the guest app
An unauthenticated visitor to the guest app is redirected to sign in

requirements.statement: Guests can view the assets currently assigned to them

criteria.must: A signed-in Guest sees only the assets assigned to them, not the whole inventory

requirements.statement: Guests can submit a request, either for new equipment or about an issue with an assigned asset

criteria.must: A Guest can submit a new-equipment request with a description
A Guest can submit an issue request against one of their assigned assets
A newly submitted request starts in the open status

requirements.statement: Guests can view the status of their own requests

criteria.must: A signed-in Guest can see the current status of each request they raised
A Guest cannot see another Guest's requests

requirements.statement: Admins can view all Guest requests

criteria.must: An Admin can view a list of every request raised by every Guest

requirements.statement: Admins can update a request's status

criteria.must: An Admin can set a request's status to approved
An Admin can set a request's status to rejected
An Admin can set a request's status to resolved
The Guest who raised a request sees its updated status after an Admin changes it
